newsitem.title: USA: Marine Drilling expects improvement in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Marine Drilling expects improvement in Q4.

text.p: Marine Drilling Cos Inc said Monday it expects continue improvement in its operating results during the upcoming fourth quarter.
The company, which owns and operates 14 jack-up drilling rigs in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico, the U.A.E. and India, attributed the projection to continued increasees in day rates.

Company President and Chief Executive Jan Rask said in a statement that its rigs were "100 percent utilized at an average day rate of approximately $24,900 compared to second quarter performance of 100 percent and $23,500, respectively."
For the third quarter, the company posted a net profit of $6.69 million, or $0.15 per share, compared with a net loss in the previous year's third quarter of $597,000, or $0.01 per share.
The company said this year's third quarter results were its best in more than 10 years.
